lines.text: I'll protect you, Commander!
Commander, Rapi, Anis, Neon... You're all the best!
I think bandages are great. They make me feel warm inside.
I like you Commander, way more than Rapi, Anis, or Neon!

The bandages you gave me are my most treasured possession.
I won't share them with anyone.
I'm so elated Commander, just over the moon!
Commander, are we playing Red Light, Green Light?
Hehe, I like staying still like this 'cause then I can watch you all the time!
This place makes me feel warm inside. Just like with you, Commander.
Anis kicked me out of the dormitory because I sprinkled flour everywhere.
Commander! Let's go for a wao... wall... What's the word? Ah, that's it! Let's go for a waook!
I said I would protect you Commander, and I will.
It's amazing!
I've become stronger!
I will continue to protect you.
This is kind of like a bandage, right?
You're the best, Commander!
Every time I get one of your gifts, my heart flutters.
Commander, I miss you so much. I miss you every single day.
Whenever I'm around you, I feel warm inside.
I like you, Commander. I really do.
I will always protect you, Commander!
Yes, Commander!
Want me to go there?
Encoming Incounter... Is that right?
I've got your back!
Can I attack now?
Are you in danger? Let me at 'em!
Re...loa...ding!
I'll reload right now.
Uh... Rapi told me so...
Ready or not, here I come!
You're mine!
Everyone, give 'em everything you've got!
... Poor thing.
Huh? They're all down.
Did I do well?
Ow!
Argh!
Ow!
Commander... I'm so sorry...
Chalk up another victory for the Commander!
Why is your clothing all so big, Commander?
Wow, the sleeves are so long! Like dangly bandages.

This doll is just like you, Commander.
I'll never let it out of my sight.
I love your smell, Commander.
Whenever I hug you tight, I fall fast asleep.
Wearing these clothes makes me feel like you're giving me a hug.

Commander? Where did you go? 
Can I try on more of your other clothes?

Commander, where are you?
How do you do these buttons?

Anis keeps saying that she thought I was a ghost,
but what does she mean?
I am on a walk with Commander!

Commander, the fridge is packed to the brim with Anis's sodas.
Let's go empty it out together.
Your clothes smell of you. It's wonderful!
Can I wear another piece of your clothing now?
I've become stronger!
I feel so powerful all of a sudden.
Can I wear this too?
Wow, this has your smell on it too!
You're supposed to say 'thank you' at a time like this, right? Thank you!
I really like you, Commander, more than flour!
You're the best, Commander. My love for you is bigger than these gigantic clothes.
You take up all the space in my heart, Commander!
Can I wear your clothes on this mission, Commander?
Yes, Commander!
Is this the right way?
Scout!
Can't get these clothes dirty.
I'll protect you.
Commander, be careful!
Open up and say 'aaahhh', Commander!
Let's give you a little pat.
You're so cute, Commander.
Commander!
I really... really like you!
All together! Attack!
... Good bye.
I did good, right?
All right, you all are next!
Watch the clothes!
Ugh...!
Agh!
I'm sorry, Commander, I got your clothes dirty...
After all that, I deserve a compliment.
I will protect you, no matter what.

I will cherish this bandage forever,
for it is a precious treasure to me.
Do you think everyone is doing well?

So many precious things...
I must protect them all.

I think I'm starting to understand who I am.
You all have been so kind and helpful.
I want to show everyone what I can do and make them proud of me.

I'm fine.
I'm used to waiting.

I'm willing to keep waiting...
Because I don't feel lonely anymore.
It's still a place I dearly miss.
This is another place that I must protect at all costs.

This reminds me of the moments shared with everyone.
They were such joyous times.

I won't cry anymore,
because there are people who I have to look after.
Thanks to you, I'll be able to keep going.
I won't disappoint you.
I've definitely become stronger.
I've missed this.
I will cherish it.

I remember everyone used to send me heartfelt gifts quite often...
Thank you.
You've touched my heart in many ways.

I miss you... 
I miss you more than words can say.
I can't believe I can like you even more.
I'm always ready.
Yes? What is it?
Moving.
Encounter.
I guess I have no choice but to fight.
I will send you off without pain.
I will send you all away.
I can still keep fighting.
Preparing to reload.
Hold on a little longer.
I'm ready.
Return to where you belong.
I'll see it through!
Next.
I'm sorry...
Just a little more...
Ahh!
Argh...!
Ouch!
No, I wasn't... able to protect anyone...
I'm glad I was able to protect everyone.
